subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Work is tiresome. Still holidays are said to be essential in our busy life. To work without pause are worship. Holidays increase our health and slacken our dutifulness. Strenuous activities without regular is likely to tell the efficiency of work and make work more break upon delightful.
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table to make a text (a) Work is worship. (b) Still holidays are essential in our busy life. (c) To work without pause is likely to tell upon our health and slacken our dutifulness. (d) Holidays increase the efficiency of work and make work more delightful. (e) Strenuous activities without regular break are said to be tiresome.
